items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: The interviewee discusses other musicians (Ned, Joe Johnson) in the context of the interviewer mentioning Bolden, but does not mention any personal interaction, meeting, or professional relationship with Bolden himself.

ctx.x: Well, he was from, I think, Cinderella, La Platt, somewhere out there. Came down the river. Yeah, well, he was sensational. He was a fair. He was a fair kind of player.

And another fellow, Ned. I never heard that's his last name or first name. Do you remember anything about him? Ned. Ned, you see. Came after Bolden and there was some who played maybe a little bit with Frankie Doosman for a while. I don't even hear all those stories. I don't know what's the name.
I don't remember Ned. You don't remember Ned. But I remember Joe Johnson and, oh, who was the other guy?
